style_decision: Anchor on the Quaternius flat-shaded family (poly.pizza Quaternius singles + Quaternius Cyberpunk Game Kit) at real human scale, with the Kenney Building Kit as the room shell. Reasons, verified on disk: (1) the only CC0 hooded humanoid with baked clips is Quaternius' 'Hoodie Character' (1.87 m tall, 24 clips, flat untextured materials, hoodie is a single 'Purple' material - a one-line per-agent recolour); (2) Quaternius desk (1.82x0.92 m), office chair (1.13 m), damaged couch, shelf, boxes, cables, computers and neon signs are all untextured named-colour materials with the same chunky proportions and the same author, so they sit next to that character without a scale or shading mismatch; (3) the Kenney Building Kit is human-scaled (2.4 m walls, 2x2 m floor tiles, 2.1 m hinged doors with open/close clips) and uses one flat colormap, so a dark-concrete override is one texture swap. Rejected as anchors: Kenney Mini Characters are 0.67 m chibi and would force every prop to mini scale (only the arcade cabinet exists at that scale); KayKit Adventurers Rogue_Hooded is a fantasy cape+mask on a gradient-atlas texture with no sit clip and clips in separate rig files; KayKit furniture/dungeon are palette-atlas textured and toy-proportioned; the Kenney Furniture Kit is authored at ~0.5 scale (desk 0.38 m tall, wall 1.29 m) and is used only for a few flat-coloured fillers scaled x2. NOTE: kenney-city-kit-industrial listed by the environment lane is NOT on disk (the hacker-props lane deleted it); kenney-city-kit-commercial + kenney-modular-buildings + Cyberpunk rooftop pieces cover the exterior instead.

character.clip_notes: All 24 clips verified from the GLB JSON; names carry the 'CharacterArmature|' prefix. Loops: Idle/Idle_Neutral 1.67 s, Walk 1.33 s, Run 0.79 s, Wave 1.67 s, Interact 1.25 s, HitRecieve 0.54 s. No sit/typing/stretch/drink clip exists, so seated states are posed in code on the 62-joint rig (Hips, UpperLeg.L/R, LowerLeg.L/R, Foot.L/R for the sit; LowerArm.L/R + Wrist.L/R oscillation for typing; Head/Neck tilt for think; Shoulder/UpperArm raise for stretch; LowerArm.R + Wrist.R arc with the soda prop for drink). Optional upgrade: retarget SitDown/StandUp from quaternius-ultimate-animated-character/glTF/Casual_Male.gltf in Blender - same bone naming family (Body/Hips/Abdomen/Torso/Neck/Head/Shoulder/UpperArm/LowerArm/UpperLeg/LowerLeg/Foot) but the hoodie rig adds Chest/Wrist/fingers/PT and its rest-pose quaternions differ (FBX2glTF export), so it needs rest-pose alignment, not a plain name copy.

conversion_notes: All chosen files are glTF 2.0 (GLB or .gltf+bin), Y-up, metres, so no axis flip is needed for RealityKit; export USDZ from Blender per asset. (1) Every poly.pizza/Quaternius GLB (hoodie character, Cyberpunk kit, workstations singles) came through FBX2glTF: mesh/armature nodes carry scale [100,100,100] and rotation -90 deg about X - apply transforms in Blender (Ctrl+A) and bake so the skin stays 1.87 m; keep the armature's 'CharacterArmature' node as root, and strip the 'CharacterArmature|' clip prefix when naming RealityKit AnimationResources. The hoodie has 4 skins (Feet/Legs/Head/Body) sharing one 62-joint skeleton; keep them as separate meshes so 'Purple' on Casual_Body can be a per-agent material. (2) Scale normalisation table: Kenney Furniture Kit x1.6-2.0 (authored ~half scale), Kenney Food Kit x0.3-0.45, Kenney Mini Arcade x2.4, Kenney City Kit Commercial x8-12, Modular Buildings x3.2, Quaternius desk 0.85, couch 0.85, shelf 0.65, TV 0.45, Computer Large 1.0; poly.pizza singles with odd scales/origins (can_fridge, mug_milkandbanana, light-bulb, propane-tank, jacket, wireless-machine, cpu, monitor_armory) must be recentred to origin and rescaled by bounding box, not trusted at x1. (3) Cables and pendant light are authored hanging in -Y from their anchor; keep the anchor at the ceiling/wall top. (4) Textures: Quaternius materials are untextured baseColorFactor - override by material name (Purple, Screen, Orange, Texture_Signs, Chair). Kenney GLBs reference external PNGs by relative uri (Building Kit: Models/GLB format/Textures/colormap.png and Models/Textures/variation-a.png; Mini Arcade / Food Kit: Textures/colormap.png) - import with the pack folder intact so Blender resolves them, then pack/embed. Damaged couch and CreativeTrio items embed a small atlas (bufferView) - fine as is. (5) Animation: hoodie clips are baked per-joint (Idle_Neutral touches 21 channels, Walk 37) at 1.67 s / 1.33 s loops; Building Kit door clips (open/close/open-and-close) target the 'door' node - keep node names so they can also be posed directly. (6) Emissive: add emissiveFactor to Screen/Texture_Signs/monitor faces at conversion so RealityKit picks up the glow without runtime material edits. (7) Dedupe: Cyberpunk kit files, polypizza-hacker-props and poly-pizza-workstations contain identical GLBs (same poly.pizza ids: Computer Large or4LLmesjq, TV tdXTODKZlx, Cable aoNcGMnNiG, Cable Long WNfAG8VSD5, damaged couch ik7UZdELJE, shelf TDgvIuorcX) - convert once from the path listed here. Total on-disk source set is 213 MB; only ~30 MB of it is referenced by this selection.
